name: Dwarf & Dragon

features.name: Splitting symbols
features.description: Split in half and double their value.

features.name: Multiplier egg wilds
features.description: 2x–10x wilds that pay twice when split.

review:
A 5x4 fantasy game with lamps, dynamite, hammers and maps. Splitting symbols divide in half and double their value, making bigger wins.

Golden dragon-egg wilds carry 2x, 3x, 5x or 10x multipliers – and pay twice if the wild splits. Three, four or five bonus symbols give 10, 15 or 25 free spins, which can retrigger. Pragmatic calls it high volatility. Note the lower 95.54% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: No confirmed official max win figure
